correctness.rationale: Reconstructed normalized orthonormal ternary contrasts and exact signed kernel rows. Scalar dynamic program F_m(z) splits a row at a ternary node and carries inherited z; symmetry, convexity and 1-Lipschitz comparison reduce four local actions to B for |z|<1/2 and D for |z|>1/2, with boundary tie. Induction yields the claimed piecewise affine formula and U_d=d+5/6−1/(2·3^d). For m>=2 the strict Lipschitz bound forces intermediate visited digits 1 or 2, while first and last are unrestricted; hence 9*2^(d-2) norming words. Independently brute-forced all ancestral sign assignments for every kernel row through depth 4, reproducing norms 5/3,25/9,103/27,391/81 and norming counts 3,9,18,36. All-depth conclusion rests on Bellman induction, not low-depth enumeration.
